Metadata.InquiriesOrToReportAnIssue: Contact information or reporting mechanisms are not explicitly mentioned. However, for dermatologists, DermGPT is free to use, and they can sign up on the website. www.dermgpt.com [SOURCE 3]
Metadata.GlobalAvailability: DermGPT is available globally for dermatologists to use, although the primary focus appears to be within the United States [SOURCE 3, 4]
Metadata.Summary: DermGPT is an AI chatbot developed by Dr. Faranak Kamangar to aid dermatologists in clinical tasks by providing quick access to dermatology information, drafting patient education handouts, and automating administrative tasks such as prior authorizations. It leverages a curated database of peer-reviewed articles for reliable and trustworthy answers [SOURCE 3, 4].
Metadata.Keywords: AI; dermatology; chatbot; clinical efficiency; prior authorization; patient education; psoriasis; eczema

UsesAndDirections.IntendedUseAndWorkflow: DermGPT is intended for use by dermatologists and their staff to improve clinical efficiency by providing quick access to information, assisting with patient management, creating patient education handouts, and automating tasks such as prior authorizations and answering patient inquiries [SOURCE 3, 4]. Physicians can use DermGPT to look up dermatology information including diagnoses, treatments, and prior authorization criteria.
UsesAndDirections.PrimaryIntendedUsers: The primary intended users are dermatologists, dermatology residents, registered nurses (RNs), medical assistants (MAs), and ancillary staff within dermatology practices [SOURCE 3, 4].
UsesAndDirections.NecessaryKnowledgeExpertise: Users need a basic understanding of dermatology and clinical workflows. The platform's user interface is designed to be intuitive, but it's meant to be used by trained medical professionals and staff [SOURCE 4].
UsesAndDirections.HowToUse: DermGPT can be accessed through www.dermgpt.com. Dermatologists can sign up for free and use it by asking questions in natural language to receive relevant, helpful answers related to dermatology diagnoses, treatments, and prior authorization criteria. It can be used to look up information, answer patient questions, and access handouts [SOURCE 3, 4].
UsesAndDirections.TargetedPatientPopulation: While not directly for patients, DermGPT is intended to indirectly benefit patients by improving the efficiency and accuracy of dermatologists, leading to better patient care and access to treatments, particularly those with inflammatory skin diseases like psoriasis and eczema [SOURCE 3, 4].
UsesAndDirections.PatientConsentOrDisclosureRequiredOrSugg: Patient consent or disclosure is not explicitly mentioned; however, standard practices regarding patient data and privacy should be followed when using the tool to generate patient-related information [SOURCE 3, 4].

Warnings.DeveloperSuppliedWarnings: DermGPT does not replace medical care or decision-making; it should not be used as a stand-alone decision maker but as an assistant. It lacks human creativity, intuition, and the ability to think outside the box [SOURCE 4].
Warnings.ModelLimitations: DermGPT lacks human creativity, intuition, and the ability to think outside the box; it is most powerful when paired with a dermatology provider or staff who can complement its skills with their higher-level creative problem-solving [SOURCE 4].

TrustIngredients.AISystemFacts: DermGPT is an AI chatbot built on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles designed to streamline clinical tasks, improve access to dermatologic data, and help save time for physicians [SOURCE 3, 4]. It is a language-based model that provides easily accessible high-quality data, patient education, research, and data analysis [SOURCE 4].
TrustIngredients.InteractionWithOtherSystems: DermGPT can integrate with existing EHR systems to streamline documentation and facilitate seamless information exchange [SOURCE 4].
TrustIngredients.OutcomesAndOutput: DermGPT can provide healthcare providers a quick reference for medication options, dosing, and interactions, summarize diagnosis and treatment guidelines for complex cases, suggest appropriate labs, imaging, and procedures for diagnostic workups, and automate documentation such as visit notes, orders, and prescriptions [SOURCE 4]. It also assists with study guides for Board Exams and provides informed consent language regarding procedures and telehealth consults [SOURCE 4].
TrustIngredients.TypeAndValueOfSolutionOutput: DermGPT provides dermatologists with relevant and helpful answers in natural language, similar to a real-life colleague [SOURCE 4]. It saves dermatologists time, leading to more efficient patient care, decreased wait times, and less physician burnout [SOURCE 4].
TrustIngredients.ExplanationForHowAnOutputIsGenerated: DermGPT pulls information from trusted, physician-approved sources, specifically a proprietary database instead of general internet sources [SOURCE 3, 4].
TrustIngredients.InputDataSource: DermGPT is built on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles [SOURCE 3].
TrustIngredients.OutputInputDataType: DermGPT accepts questions in natural language and provides relevant answers [SOURCE 4].
TrustIngredients.DevelopmentDataCharacterization: DermGPT's database is proprietary and consists of trusted, physician-approved sources [SOURCE 4].
TrustIngredients.DatasetTransparency: DermGPT's database only pulls from trusted, physician-approved sources, ensuring scientifically sound information sourced from peer-reviewed medical journals [SOURCE 4].
TrustIngredients.RelevanceOfTrainingDataToIntendedPopulat: DermGPT is built on over 3,000 peer-reviewed articles, ensuring specificity and reliability in its answers for dermatology-related questions [SOURCE 3].
TrustIngredients.BiasMitigationApproaches: By using a dermatology-specific database, DermGPT aims to reduce errors and hallucinations, making it more trustworthy than general language models [SOURCE 3, 4].
TrustIngredients.OngoingMaintenance: DermGPT is continuously updated and improved, unlike some other AI tools [SOURCE 4].
TrustIngredients.TransparencyIntelligibilityAndAccountabi: DermGPT aims to provide easily accessible, high-quality data to aid in decision-making in dermatology [SOURCE 4].
TrustIngredients.TransparencyInformation: DermGPT is powered by proven, curated AI and allows dermatologists to ask questions in natural language and receive relevant, helpful answers [SOURCE 4].

UsefulnessEfficacy.GoalOfMetrics: DermGPT aims to improve patient care and streamline dermatology practices by assisting with clinical tasks and making dermatology information readily available [SOURCE 4]. The goal is to save time and improve access to dermatologic data for dermatologists and their staff [SOURCE 4].
UsefulnessEfficacy.Result: Minutes saved in a day because of DermGPT will yield more efficient patient care, decreased wait times to see a dermatologist, and less physician burnout [SOURCE 4].
UsefulnessEfficacy.Interpretation: DermGPT is most powerful when paired with a dermatology provider or staff who can complement its skills with their higher-level creative problem-solving, strengthening the ability to care for patients [SOURCE 4].
